title.value: The patient advisor, an organizational resource as a lever for an enhanced oncology patient experience (PAROLE-onco): a longitudinal multiple case study protocol
title.justification: The title was explicitly stated at the beginning of the document.
title.quote: The patient advisor, an organizational resource as a lever for an enhanced oncology patient experience (PAROLE-onco): a longitudinal multiple case study protocol

analysis.description: The study aims to explore the integration of patient advisors into clinical oncology teams to enhance patient support and experience. It uses a mixed-methods approach to assess the feasibility, effects, and legal/ethical implications of this integration.

type.justification: The paper describes a study protocol involving mixed-methods longitudinal case studies conducted across multiple sites to assess the integration of patient advisors into oncology teams.
type.quote: Methods/design: We will conduct six mixed methods longitudinal case studies.

name.justification: The study focuses on improving healthcare services through the integration of patient advisors in oncology healthcare teams.

name.justification: The study specifically targets oncology patients and healthcare services around cancer care.
